description: This file contains a static helper class 'NavigationHelper' for building and managing navigation menus in an OrchardCore application, including menu population, selection, and state management.

methods.name: UseLegacyFormat
methods.description: Checks if the legacy admin menu navigation format should be used based on a switch.

methods.name: PopulateMenuAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously populates the menu shapes and applies selection based on current context.

methods.name: PopulateMenuLevelAsync
methods.description: Recursively populates menu items at a specific level.

methods.name: BuildMenuItemShapeAsync
methods.description: Builds a shape for a menu item, setting properties and handling URL query strings.

methods.name: MarkAsSelectedIfMatchesQueryOrCookie
methods.description: Marks a menu item as selected if it matches query parameters or cookies.

methods.name: ApplySelection
methods.description: Ensures only one menu item (and its ancestors) are marked as selected.

methods.name: GetHighestPrioritySelectedMenuItem
methods.description: Finds the selected menu item with the highest priority.
